documents.name: Proof of U.S. citizenship OR green card (front and back)

Passport biographic page
Marriage certificate (original or certified copy)
Proof of termination of all prior marriages (if applicable)
Photos together over time, labeled with dates/locations

Travel records (flight itineraries, boarding passes, hotel bookings)

Correspondence (emails, chats, SMS, call records)

parent_abroad.title: Application for Parent Abroad
parent_abroad.subtitle: Petition for Alien Relative (Parent)
parent_abroad.description: sponsoring your parent who is currently abroad to come to the United States

documents.name: Proof of U.S. citizenship (birth certificate, U.S. passport bio page, or Certificate of Naturalization/Citizenship)
Government-issued photo ID
U.S. citizen child's birth certificate showing parent's name
If adopted: final adoption decree + proof of legal custody and residency before age 16
If step-parent: marriage certificate of U.S. citizen child's parent + proof of termination of prior marriages
If father & child born out of wedlock: proof of legitimation or emotional/financial relationship
Paternal or maternal DNA test result from a USCIS-approved lab

sections.title: At Least Five (5) of the Following — Required

Church or religious records listing parent and child's name
Insurance records naming both petitioner and beneficiary
Employment records showing parent and child's names
Financial records (tax returns) listing parent and child's name
Census or tribal records in both names
Government records or ID documents showing names of both
Proof of ongoing parent-child relationship (money transfers/remittance)
Passport biographic page
Marriage certificate, divorce decree, adoption decree, or court order for name changes (if applicable)

documents.name: Proof of U.S. citizenship
Government-issued photo ID
Petitioner's birth certificate
Sibling's birth certificate (showing at least one common parent)

If adopted siblings: adoption decrees + proof both adopted by same parent(s) before age 16
If step-siblings: marriage certificate of common parent to stepparent + proof of prior marriage terminations (relationship formed before age 18)
